title: U.S. House, District 22
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 22th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Open, newly drawn seat (Rep. Lois Frankel moved to CD 23). Roster from Florida Politics and NBC6: Casey Askar (R) vs. Pia Dandiya (D). No NPA candidate identified; absence unconfirmed. Sources: https://floridapolitics.com/archives/814079-casey-askar-pia-dandiya-to-compete-for-new-cd-22-seat-after-winning-their-primary-races-tuesday/ ; https://www.nbcmiami.com/news/politics/decision/results-of-floridas-district-22-republican-primary-election/3846233/ ; https://www.nbcmiami.com/news/politics/decision/results-of-floridas-district-22-democratic-primary/3846238/ ; county makeup per WUSF map breakdown. Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Casey Askar
candidates.background: Casey Askar, described in coverage as a food-industry businessman, won the crowded Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary for the new 22nd District with about 31% of the vote, ahead of fintech entrepreneur Michael Carbonara (about 19%) and Keiser University vice chancellor Belinda Keiser (about 18%); Marine veteran David Burck also ran. The Cook Political Report rates the redrawn district R+4.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18, 2026 Republican primary with ~31% over Carbonara (~19%), Keiser (~18%) and Burck (Florida Politics; NBC6)
